correctness.rationale: Exact Lie derivatives, invariant-half-space decomposition, cutoff arguments for conditional and logarithmic balances, and equality-set tangency give the stated formulas and rigidity; symbolic residual checks agree exactly.

originality.rationale: The 1979 conservative energy law and Tsegel'nik's 2016 special nonautonomous first integral are prior art and are excluded. Targeted searches across later RF bifurcation, hidden-attractor, generalized-model, and 2026 statistical literature found no equivalent conditional invariant-measure law, paired square defects, equality classification, or universal barriers; residual older-literature risk is stated.

value.rationale: The theorem gives parameter-exact, simulation-independent constraints on arbitrary compact invariant statistical states and strict universal amplitude/height barriers for all nonconstant periodic orbits in a system otherwise studied predominantly numerically.
